validity.uncertaintyStatement: Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.
validity.explanation: Uncalibrated estimate: about 500 MPa axial stress after the declared thermal cycle in a fully constrained bar. The model uses the supplied inputs and ideal plasticity. It omits three-dimensional restraint, relaxation, phase-transformation strain and temperature-dependent properties. The bar remains constrained. In a fully constrained bar this equals the yield strength you supplied whenever thermal strain exceeds twice the yield strain. It is an upper-bound scenario, not a prediction of the part's stress. This result is saturated at the supplied return-temperature yield strength. Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.

uncertainty.construction: Incremental return mapping over the declared cycle; no interval.
